title: Compliance & audit
summary: Product-direction PRD for the enterprise Compliance & audit vertical built on LocalMind's universal knowledge-graph engine, making compliance demonstrable and local-first.
scope: graph node types: Framework, Requisito, Controllo, Evidenza, Asset, Processo, Rischio, Policy, Trattamento(GDPR), Persona/Ruolo, Fornitore, Audit, Finding, Incidente, RemediationTask, AuditTrailEntry
graph edge/relation types: SODDISFA, DIMOSTRA, EQUIVALE_A, SOSTITUISCE, SI_APPLICA_A, MITIGA, MINACCIA, RESPONSABILE_DI, GOVERNA, VIOLA, RILEVA, CORREGGE, DIPENDE_DA, REGISTRA
weighted edges (evidence freshness, automation, human-validation, source reliability, path aggregation)

MVP feature set: compliance graph model (MySQL nodes+weighted edges, Flyway), CRUD framework/requirements/controls (/api/v1/compliance/*), normative ingestion (PDF->segmentation->Qdrant embedding), SODDISFA/EQUIVALE_A mapping with AI human-in-the-loop, evidence management with hash, evidence freshness, coverage & gap analysis, GraphRAG compliance Q&A (Ollama default), coverage dashboard, tamper-evident audit trail (hash-chain base), preloaded framework templates (ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2), IT/EN i18n

data connectors: normative texts (Tika/OCR document domain), preloaded framework templates (PF4J plugin/marketplace), public crosswalks (SCF, CSA CCM), CMDB/asset inventory (MCP), IdP LDAP/SSO (MCP+automation), cloud config/posture (MCP+automation), SIEM/logs (MCP+automation), Git/CI-CD repos (MCP), ticketing/ITSM (MCP/messaging), email/calendar evidence & deadlines, internal document store, GDPR processing register/DPIA
compliance frameworks: ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2, NIS2, DORA, GDPR, EU AI Act, PCI-DSS 4.0, NIST CSF/800-53
continuous controls monitoring, gap analysis, audit package generation, evidence hash-chain integrity, local-first sovereignty, Ollama-default GraphRAG
notes: No frontmatter. Strong PRD signals dominate (personas section, requisiti in input, MVP->evolution feature tables, KPI/success metrics, risks & mitigations). Substantial SPEC-like content present (section 5 graph data model with node/edge type tables and edge-weight criteria); PRD vs SPEC competed. Resolved to PRD because the document self-describes as a 'documento di indirizzo per gli sviluppi' (product/scope direction for a vertical) and the data model is one section serving the broader requirements framing, not a standalone implementation contract. Per-vertical roadmap-phase scope (graph model, MVP set, connectors) captured in scope[].
